title: The kind of cake that feels like a hug
excerpt: A buttery little cake, a handful of berries, and absolutely no special occasion required.
body:
Today’s kitchen experiment: a simple berry cake for the middle of the week. I’m testing a softer crumb with yogurt and a little lemon zest.

My favorite part? The berries sink into the batter and leave little pockets of jam. Next time, I’ll try raspberries and a sprinkle of crunchy sugar on top. A work in progress, and a very delicious one.
